verdict.rationale: Mintlify supports natural-language operation via its chat assistant, an editor built-in agent that edits pages/navigation/settings from NL instructions, and MCP servers (read and write) that let AI tools like Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT operate the docs site conversationally; runtime probes confirm these MCP endpoints and the CLI are live and functional, not just vendor claims. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on user reports specifically testing natural-language command operation, and confirmation of assistant/agent behavior quality from third parties.
